title: plan-2026-09-open-issues.md: 9 present-tense claims in its standing sections are false or stale at the baseline
claim: Nine units of dev/programme/plan-2026-09-open-issues.md, in sections the file says a fresh session reads first, contradict the baseline's code: one false since written (web-fix-wave.js 'stops merging' after a red main) and eight stale.
mechanism: The file restates the protocol 'because a fresh session reads this file first', but its standing sections were not re-truthed as the code moved. False: 'web-fix-wave.js logs MAIN IS RED after <group> and stops merging' -- the merge chain never reads the previous gate, so the next group merges after a red main (merges_after_red=1; the same chain at 81216e67c6, where the sentence was written). Stale: the verdict grammar (`Fix review: merge` / `Fix review: blocked — <why>`, both refused by bus.sh verdict_sha); cross_seam_fraction's tolerance band (retired, budgeted nowhere); '.cursor/rules/*.mdc still hold three alwaysApply policies' (10 of 10) and 'Claude Code loads CLAUDE.md and nothing else' (10 .claude/rules files load on paths: globs), 'all three' at seat start; 'fixer.md step 5 mandates [the gate lock]' (0 mentions); the License badge 'still unfixed' (its target is absolute now); docs/architecture.md 'still reads 65 entities / ...' (0 occurrences) and 'tests/entities.py's census covers README.md only' (it reads architecture.md now). Path spellings that left the tree are not counted: tests/layout.json lists the file `historical` (tvofi's D2), and those 29 rows are kept apart as [D2 path].
